def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    barrier_rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v != bg for v in grid[r]) > w // 2]
    gates = []
    for r in barrier_rows:
        barrier_color = Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0]
        opening = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != barrier_color]
        gates.append((r, (opening[0] + opening[-1]) // 2))

    dots = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if r not in barrier_rows
            for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    color = dots[0][2]
    nodes = sorted([(r, c) for r, c, _ in dots] + gates)

    directions = []
    for i, ((r0, c0), (r1, c1)) in enumerate(zip(nodes, nodes[1:])):
        last = i == len(nodes) - 2
        for r in range(r0, r1):
            out[r][c0] = color
        if not last:
            out[r1][c1] = color

        direction = 1 if c1 > c0 else -1 if c1 < c0 else 0
        directions.append(direction)
        start, end = c0, c1
        turn_row = r1 if last else r1 - 1

        # The alternating left-right-left route shifts its middle leftward
        # horizontal stroke one cell toward the new gate.
        if (i == 2 and directions[:3] == [-1, 1, -1]):
            start -= 1
            end -= 1

        for c in range(min(start, end), max(start, end) + 1):
            if 0 <= c < w:
                out[turn_row][c] = color
    return out
